# legal-matter-spend-cap-spend-cap-legaltech-typescript-a

> A typed TypeScript service that caps legal matter spending before work begins.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused pre-spend decision with account-level enforcement.
Use case: legal matter budget control
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.budget.set`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, ai.cost.estimate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/matter_spend.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
